text:
Silver Price in 1996
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1996, the LBMA silver price fell 13.1% between 1996-01-31 ($5.52) and 1996-12-31 ($4.80). The highest sampled price was $5.52 in February and the lowest was $4.74 in November. The mean of these observations was $5.15. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
